items.synthetic: Departments report their critical data assets in returns that are not published, so no real record can be shown. Built to the April 2026 guidance, under an invented department.
It declares conformance to DCAT-AP-UK. No real catalogue has adopted this proposed profile, and showing a real one would claim a conformance it has not made.
It states which values a harvester added and which profile the record follows. Attributing that to a real central catalogue would describe behaviour it has not declared.
Details of personal data shared across borders are not published for individual datasets, and showing them for a real one would be wrong and could be harmful. Under an invented department.
It shows properties left empty on purpose. A real record with these gaps would misstate what that publisher knows or withholds.

The extensions are candidates that no publisher uses yet. Attributing their values to a real dataset would misrepresent it, so the examples build on this invented record, under an invented organisation (ADR 0020).
